prior_family: CORE pilot retained as development extraction benchmark
rationale: Issuer-paid deposits make OCTG-to-Tenaris cash-flow attribution more direct than competitor restrictions-to-domestic steel pricing. This selects a causal mechanism before event-window returns, not a proven profitable strategy.
primary_hypothesis: Dense Jev relevance/state judgments can identify company-specific operative cash-flow changes and exceptions from legal/issuer documents more accurately or cheaply than matched conventional baselines.
financial_hypothesis: Only a material, not-already-public increment with auditable latency could contain post-alert TS return information. The study must be allowed to conclude none exists.

bounded_universe.selection_rule: Include every relevant legal increment located within these frozen episodes, including null/procedural results; cap overflow is an explicit protocol amendment before prices.
bounded_universe.out_of_scope: Mechanical-pipe scope decisions, other countries, other issuers and next Mexico POR require a separate pre-return registration or versioned amendment.

holdout_policy.development: All pre-registration documents and reviewed historical outcomes are development-only.
holdout_policy.prospective: Only a genuinely new legal increment first made public after registration can become the prospective observation. Earlier-but-later-found documents must be marked contaminated retrospective development.
holdout_policy.mexico_pending_final: Candidate only; if located with earlier first-public availability, remove prospective designation.
holdout_policy.independence: Questions, passages, country rows, related legal stages and two stocks on one event are not independent returns; here the prospective target is one episode, insufficient to estimate reliable alpha.

allowed: Commerce ACCESS public notices, memoranda and case calendar
Federal Register public inspection and official GovInfo editions
SEC filings and dated issuer releases
required_metadata: source effective date distinct from information date
source_policy.as_of_rule: Every feature must be available no later than the simulated/actual decision. FY2025 disclosure and realized Argentine refund gains cannot enter a June 2025 prediction.
source_policy.calendar_rule: November 3, 2026 is the observed official candidate final announcement date for Mexico 2023–24, changeable and not an automation instruction.
source_policy.first_public_rule: Check ACCESS unpublished notice/memo, Commerce announcement, issuer release and FR public inspection before using FR publication. Date-only or conflicting timestamps make intraday diagnostics ineligible.

jev_experiment.future_run_gate: Use existing project's approved provider guardrails and an explicit finite run budget before inference; this file creates no paid call or account charge.
jev_experiment.input: New decision plus as-of prior proposal, operative state, intervening memoranda, issuer ownership/import role and timing metadata; market returns excluded.
dense_question_families: Which passages concern the exact case, exporter and review period?
Which establish a new proposal, binding operative state, partial rescission, scope result or merely historical context?
Which apply to forward deposits versus retrospective assessments and refunds?
Which exceptions change exporter/manufacturer applicability or liquidation?
Which evidence binds TAMSA/Siderca to Tenaris as of the event?
Which facts indicate importer cost effects, U.S. producer offsets, denominator or legal uncertainty?
Which evidence was public earlier, contradicts the alert or leaves materiality unknown?
jev_experiment.evidence_contract: Every positive judgment retains source span, document identity, as-of availability and supporting/contradicting evidence. Preserve ambiguous exceptions for deeper review.
jev_experiment.probability_policy: Do not multiply answer confidences or equate a Jev question score with a trading probability.
jev_experiment.expensive_reasoner_policy: Route only materially unresolved cases; capture total model and human review cost for comparison.

comparators.name: Deterministic baseline
comparators.method: Case/exporter matching, section-aware rate extraction and explicit proposal/operative rules.

comparators.name: Conventional model baseline
comparators.input: Same source corpus, prior states and review budget
comparators.method: Existing cheap conventional model with identical required output and no prices.

comparators.name: Dense Jev screen plus bounded review
comparators.method: Parallel typed passage questions, uncertainty routing, deterministic arithmetic.

evaluation_before_prices.labels: Independent human/agent adjudication grounded in primary spans; disagreements remain unresolved rather than force-labeled.
critical_fields: Final-minus-same-review-prior proposal versus prior operative difference
economic_gate: Primary issuer/importer link available as of event
Fresh legal increment after all known earlier disclosure
Importer-specific base or defensible public cash-flow bound
Forward cash and historical refund channels separated
Legal blocks and effective-date conflicts resolved enough for the asserted effect
evaluation_before_prices.no_signal_rule: Unknown net materiality, earlier-public information, unresolved applicability or timing causes abstention. A large rate percentage alone is not a material equity signal.
evaluation_before_prices.historical_selection_rule: Report all frozen episode results and nulls. Do not use the later $34m Argentine gain to choose successful historical trades or assert a June 2025 surprise.

conditional_paper_diagnostic.reason: Evidence gate not yet met; price data remains unopened.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.pre_price_lock: Before any prospective event's outcome is opened, freeze an immutable signal card with channels, side or abstention, denominator bounds, prior expectation, source timestamps, latency, eligibility and full reject rationale.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.allowed_instrument: TS ADS; one unlevered fixed-unit paper observation; no order routing.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.direction_rule: Only net issuer cash benefit/adverse effect supported by the as-of worksheet may assign long/short direction. If offsets prevent a defensible direction, abstain. Short remains hypothetical and requires obtainable borrow/cost evidence before feasibility claims.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.entry: First observable executable regular-session quote at least 15 minutes after the later of source first-seen and completed signal processing. If no auditable quote is available, no executable-return observation.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.exit: Following regular-session close using the correct exchange calendar; no optimized alternate exit.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.costs: Use contemporaneous spread, fee and slippage assumptions fixed before return inspection. No mid-price fill claims or invented cost estimates.
conditional_paper_diagnostic.benchmark: Report raw and broad-market-relative paper returns; one episode supports only a diagnostic, not a reliable alpha or Sharpe estimate.
controls: Corporate actions and ADS currency consistency
Oil/energy sector and market moves as confounds
Earnings or other simultaneous issuer releases
No changing side, horizon, universe or exclusions after observing returns

stop_or_amend_rules: If the frozen corpus cannot establish auditable exposure, timing and materiality, stop at an evidence/extraction result without buying price data.
If no relevant future increment occurs, record zero prospective observations; do not turn documents into events.
If C supplies no useful accuracy/coverage/cost improvement versus A/B, do not claim Jev-specific advantage.
Any extension to other cases, products, thresholds or horizons is versioned before return inspection and reported as additional research.
profitability_claim: Unproved. No observed event-window returns or profit estimate is contained in this registration.
